verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs explicitly state $20 free credits on sign-up plus $10/month recurring credits with no payment method required, directly enabling free prototyping, and community evidence confirms users signing up for trial accounts and testing the API without payment friction (exa-comm-1). missing for 10: no independent long-term verification of ongoing $10/month credit renewal or explicit free-tier rate limits beyond generic rate-limit doc.
